development_set_note: The 12 reviewed ads informed V4 and therefore cannot independently validate it.
resolved_root_examples: A local OR of two degree-plus-experience combinations is retained with qualification_relation_unresolved=true and unconditional=false.
An immediate duration clause after a standalone Experience heading is retained even when the duration line omits the word experience.
remaining_limits: The parser does not build a complete qualification or grade-specific relation graph; multi-sentence and semicolon-separated alternatives can remain unresolved.
Acceptable, conditional, post-hire, and timing language outside the bounded patterns can retain inherited section context.
Candidates or applicants should have is marked expected with unspecified mandatoriness, not mandatory required.
Unconventional headings embedded in long flattened prose can still fail to reset section context.
Education and tool dictionaries remain deliberately bounded.
interpretation: All outputs remain candidates for validation, not validated requirements, precision estimates, or economic measures.
